jobs.occupation: Electrical Field Service Technician (m/f/d) (Industriemechaniker/in - Geräte- und Feinwerktechnik)
jobs.description: Electrical Field Service Technician (m/f/d)located in Kiel At Caterpillar, we’re committed to our customers, who build a better, more sustainable world with our products, services and solutions. We understand and show the value of why they should choose us. We’re exploring new ideas and opportunities – innovating to discover the breakthroughs necessary for tomorrow’s growth. Through it all, we are one team (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mYIDne7Q5ek&list=PLwAXbfivFg0jmiNqqgFLeQJpRB_i-UVln&index=39)  – creating and delivering world-class products, services and solutions superior to the competition. Learn more about the Caterpillar Experience (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GvCYWtWARlk&list=PLwAXbfivFg0jmiNqqgFLeQJpRB_i-UVln&index=25) . Caterpillar Inc. is the world’s leading manufacturer of construction and mining equipment, off-highway diesel and natural gas engines, industrial gas turbines and diesel-electric locomotives.As an Electrical Field Service Technician, you will provide technical support for installation, commissioning, troubleshooting, maintenance and repair of electrical, automation and control systems associated with medium-speed diesel, gas and dual-fuel engines. You will work closely with customers, dealers, shipyards and internal technical specialists to ensure safe, reliable and efficient operation of Caterpillar Motoren products worldwide. Job duties will include but are not limited to:- Perform maintenance, installation, troubleshooting and repair activities on electrical, automation and control systems of Caterpillar Motoren products.- Provide technical support directly to customers and through the Caterpillar dealer network.- Perform diagnostics and fault finding on MACS, aMACS and associated automation platforms.- Troubleshoot electrical distribution systems, switchboards, motor control centers (MCCs), excitation systems and generator protection equipment.- Support synchronization, load sharing and load acceptance testing of generator sets.- Conduct root cause analyses and support major failure investigations.- Analyze wiring diagrams, schematics, protection philosophies and control logic documentation.- Support electrical upgrades, retrofit projects and software updates.- Prepare detailed troubleshooting and service reports.- Utilize Caterpillar digital service tools, remote diagnostics and technical information systems.- Support warranty investigations and implementation of corrective actions.- Provide technical guidance and mentoring to dealers, contractors and customer personnel.- Participate continuously in technical training programs to maintain and expand product knowledge.- Perform workshop activities, panel inspections and equipment testing when not assigned to field service activities.- Support special service projects assigned by the Team Leader.Safety Responsibilities- Perform all work in compliance with Caterpillar Environmental, Health and Safety requirements- Follow customer-specific electrical safety procedures, lockout/tagout (LOTO) requirements and permit-to-work systems.- Verify equipment isolation and safe working conditions before commencing work.- Actively promote a strong safety culture and immediately report unsafe conditions.- Ensure risk assessments and toolbox talks are completed where required.- Comply with applicable marine, offshore and power plant electrical safety standards.What You Have (Key Skills/Experience Required): - Completed vocational training as Electrical Technician, Electronics Technician, Mechatronics Technician, Marine Electrical Engineer or comparable technical qualification.- Minimum 2-4 years of field service experience with power generation, marine electrical systems, industrial automation or engine control systems.- Strong troubleshooting and diagnostic skills for electrical and automation systems.- Experience with generator protection systems, switchgear and power distribution systems is advantageous.- Familiarity with electrical power generation, protection and automation systems. Knowledge of IEC 61850 communication networks, generator protection relays and power management systems is advantageous.- Familiarity with generator synchronization and load sharing systems is advantageous.- Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams and control drawings.- Good written and spoken English skills for communication with international customers and dealers.- Strong customer focus and professional communication skills.- High level of self-organization and ability to work independently.- Willingness and ability to travel internationally up to 80%, including short-notice assignments and extended customer site visits.- Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications and digital service reporting tools.- Ability to obtain required travel documentation, visas and medical clearances necessary for international assignments.- Valid offshore medical certificate and/or fitness for international travel assignments is advantageous.What Will Put You Ahead (Preferred Skills):- Generator Protection Relays (Woodward, ABB REG, Siemens SIPROTEC)- Power Management Systems (PMS)- Governor Systems (Woodward, Regulateur Europas, Heinzmann)- Variable Frequency Drives (ABB, Danfoss, Siemens)- High Voltage Switching Authorization- Marine Automation Systems- Industrial Ethernet and Network Diagnostics- Experience with LNG, Dual-Fuel or Gas Engine ControlsWhat You Will Get:•    Varied and challenging responsibilities•    Attractive salary in line with the applicable collective agreement (starting from €3,977, depending on your experience)•    Additional payments such as holiday pay, Christmas bonus, etc.•    30 days of annual leave / working time account•    Company pension scheme•    Bike leasing / public transport ticket / wellbeing allowanceAdditional Information:We are back! This role requires being in the office five days a week.Note - Relocation assistance may be provided to candidates who meet the eligibility criteria.A valid work permit or EU-25/EFTA citizenship is required for this position.About CaterpillarCaterpillar Inc. is the world’s leading manufacturer of construction and mining equipment, off-highway diesel and natural gas engines, industrial gas turbines and diesel-electric locomotives. For the past 100 years, we’ve been helping customers build a better, more sustainable world and are committed and contributing to a reduced-carbon future. Our innovative products and services, backed by our global dealer network, provide exceptional value that helps customers succeed.We value authenticity and encourage candidates to submit original, personally crafted responses throughout our hiring process. Use of AI-generated content may disadvantage your application.

jobs.occupation: wissenschaftliche\*r Mitarbeiter\*in (Post-Doc) (w/m/d) (Chemiker/in)
jobs.description: Die Universität Paderborn ist eine leistungsstarke und international orientierte Campus-Universität. In interdisziplinären Teams gestalten wir zukunftsweisende Forschung, innovative Lehre sowie den aktiven Wissenstransfer in die Gesellschaft. Als wichtige Forschungs- und Kooperationspartnerin prägt die Universität auch regionale Entwicklungsstrategien. Unseren Beschäftigten in Forschung, Lehre, Technik und Verwaltung bieten wir ein lebendiges, familienfreundliches und chancengerechtes Arbeitsumfeld mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und vielfältigen Möglichkeiten. Gestalten Sie mit uns die Zukunft!In der Fakultät für Naturwissenschaften – Department Chemie – ist im Rahmen des interdisziplinären Forschungsvorhabens ML4Fouling zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt eine Stelle alswissenschaftliche*r Mitarbeiter*in (Post-Doc) (w/m/d) (Entgeltgruppe 13 TV-L)im Umfang von 100 % der regelmäßigen Arbeitszeit zu besetzen. Es handelt sich um eine Qualifizierungsstelle im Sinne des Wissenschaftszeitvertragsgesetzes (WissZeitVG), die zur Förderung der folgenden wiss. Qualifizierung besetzt wird: Projektakquise und -management im Bereich der Naturwissenschaften. Die Stelle ist befristet, abhängig von der bisher erreichten Qualifizierung, jedoch für die Dauer von i. d. R. 2 Jahren zu besetzen, da dieser Zeitraum zur Förderung des Qualifizierungsziels als angemessen angesehen wird.Aufgabenbereich:• Durchführung experimenteller (u. a. elektrochemischer, spektroskopischer, mikroskopischer) Analysen zur Detektion initialerAblagerungsprozesse an umströmten Oberflächen• Analyse des Einflusses von Materialeigenschaften, Fluidzusammensetzung und Strömungsbedingungen auf makromolekulareAblagerungsprozesse• Atomistische Simulation (sowohl DFT- als auch Kraftfeld-basiert) von Adsorptions- und Desorptionsprozessen an Fest-Flüssig-Grenzflächen• Entwicklung und Validierung von Machine-Learning-Modellen zur Vorhersage der Belagsbildung in technischen und medizintechnischenSystemen• Präsentation der wissenschaftlichen Erkenntnisse in nationalen und internationalen Konferenzen• Publikation der wissenschaftlichen Erkenntnisse in internationalen Fachzeitschriften• Lehrverpflichtung im Umfang von i. d. R. 4 SWS, primär in deutschsprachigen VeranstaltungenEinstellungsvoraussetzungen:• Abgeschlossene Promotion in Chemie, Physik, Materialwissenschaft oder einem verwandten naturwissenschaftlichen Bereich• Nachgewiesene Kenntnisse im Bereich Elektrochemie, Grenzflächenchemie und/oder -analytik sowie atomistischen Simulationen• Kenntnisse im Bereich maschinelles Lernen und/oder in der Arbeit mit datengetriebenen Methoden sowie der Erzeugung entsprechenderTrainingsdaten sind wünschenswert• Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und SchriftWir bieten Ihnen:• Ein interdisziplinäres Forschungsumfeld an der Schnittstelle von Technischer Chemie, Theoretischer Chemie und Machine-Learning• Abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit in einem universitätsintern ausgezeichneten Forschungsprojekt• Zugang zu den Hochleistungsrechnern des Paderborn Center for Parallel Computing (PC2)• Flexible Arbeitszeitgestaltung sowie die individuelle Möglichkeit zur mobilen Arbeit• Vielzahl von Gesundheits-, Beratungs- und Präventionsangeboten• Attraktive Nebenleistungen wie Kinderbetreuungsmöglichkeiten und Sportangebote• Möglichkeit zur internen und externen Fort- und Weiterbildung• Zusätzliche Leistungen nach dem Tarifvertrag der Länder (TV-L) wie Jahressonderzahlung und vermögenswirksame Leistungen sowie dieZusatzversorgung der VBLBewerbungen von Frauen sind ausdrücklich erwünscht und werden gem. Landesgleichstellungsgesetz NRW (LGG) bei gleicher Eignung, Befähigung und fachlicher Leistung bevorzugt berücksichtigt, sofern nicht in der Person eines Mitbewerbers liegende Gründe überwiegen. Teilzeitbeschäftigung ist grundsätzlich möglich. Ebenso ist die Bewerbung geeigneter Schwerbehinderter und Gleichgestellter im Sinne des Sozialgesetzbuches Neuntes Buch (SGB IX) erwünscht.Bewerbungen mit den üblichen Unterlagen werden unter Angabe der Kennziffer 7460 bis zum 4. Dezember 2026 erbeten an vanessa.nesslinger@unipaderborn.de.Informationen zur Verarbeitung Ihrer personenbezogenen Daten finden Sie unter:www.uni-paderborn.de/zv/personaldatenschutz.Prof. Dr. Martin BrehmFakultät für NaturwissenschaftenUniversität PaderbornWarburger Str. 10033098 PaderbornPaderborn University is a high-performance and internationally oriented university. Within interdisciplinary teams, we undertake forward-looking research, design innovative teaching concepts and actively transfer knowledge into society. As an important research and cooperation partner, the university also shapes regional development strategies. We offer our employees in research, teaching, technology and administration a lively, family-friendly and equal opportunity environment, a lean management structure and diverse opportunities. Join us to invent the future!As part of the interdisciplinary research project ML4Fouling, at the Faculty of Science – Department of Chemistry –, the following position is to be filled as soon as possiblePostdoctoral Researcher (f/m/d)(Salary level according to 13 TV-L)with 100% of the regular working hours. This is a qualification position within the meaning of the German Act on Fixed-Term Research Employment Contracts for Academic Staff (Wissenschaftszeitvertragsgesetz “WissZeitVG”), which serves to promote the following academic qualification: project acquisition and management in natural sciences. The position is initially limited for a period of two years.Duties and responsibilities:• Conducting experimental (including electrochemical, spectroscopic, and microscopic) analyses to detect initial adsorption processes on surfaces exposed to fluid flow• Analyzing the influence of material properties, fluid composition, and flow conditions on macromolecular deposition processes• Atomistic simulation (both DFT- and force-field-based) of adsorption and desorption processes at solid-liquid interfaces• Developing and validating predictive machine learning (ML) models for deposition processes in technical and biomedical systems• Presenting scientific findings at national and international conferences• Publishing scientific findings in international peer-reviewed journals• Teaching duties usually amounting to 4 teaching hours (SWS) per week, primarily in German-language coursesRecruitment requirements:• Completed PhD in chemistry, physics, materials science, or a related field in the natural sciences• Proven knowledge in the fields of electrochemistry, interface chemistry and/or interface analysis, as well as atomistic simulations• Knowledge in the field of machine learning and/or in working with data-driven methods, as well as the generation of corresponding training data, is desirable• Excellent written and spoken English skillsWe offer:• An interdisciplinary research environment bridging technical chemistry, theoretical chemistry, and machine learning• The opportunity to be part of a research project recognized with a university award• Access to the high-performance computing facilities of the Paderborn Center for Parallel Computing (PC2)• Flexible working hours and the individual option of mobile working• Wide range of health, counseling and prevention services• Attractive fringe benefits such as childcare facilities and sports activities• Opportunities for internal and external training and development• Additional benefits in accordance with the collective agreement of the federal states (TV-L), such as annual bonuses and capital-forming benefits as well as the VBL supplementary pension schemeApplications from women are particularly welcome and, in case of equal qualifications and experiences, will receive preferential treatment according to state law (LGG), unless there are preponderant reasons to give preference to another applicant. Part-time employment is generally possible. Applications from disabled people with appropriate suitability are explicitly welcome. This also applies to people with equal opportunities in accordance with the German social law SGB IX.Please send your application documents (preferably in a single pdf file) using the Ref. No. 7460 until December, 4th 2026 to vanessa.nesslinger@uni-paderborn.de.

You implement security measures, ensure compliance, and engage stakeholders with clear, focused communication.Solutions – You define guidelines, standards, and manage infrastructure to deliver and maintain SAP S/4HANA-based processes and solutions, ensuring end-to-end integration and optimization within the cloud environment.Innovations – You assess emerging cloud technologies, evaluate SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud and SAP BTP innovations, and drive continuous improvement by leveraging tools for automation and efficiency.Your profile- You have completed your studies in computer science, economics, or a comparable field.- You bring several years of experience in SAP BTP management and SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud integrations.- You have in-depth knowledge of modern technologies such as cloud management platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud) and infrastructure-as-code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or Ansible.- You have in-depth knowledge of modern technologies such as cloud management platforms, especially SAP Business Technology Platform- You have extensive experience in configuring and optimizing SAP BTP to SAP S/4HANA integrations.- You are fluent in English and German both spoken and written.- Your analytical, independent, and structured approach to work supports you defining guidelines. Furthermore, your communication enables effective collaboration with various teams.Your benefitsFlexibility – We encourage you to choose your working hours and your working place the way that suits you and your lifestyle. We do not have core working hours and we also offer you the possibility of home office or temporary work from abroad. Always in accordance with operational requirements and labor law regulations. Career Development – We are passionate about your personal and professional development, therefore we offer your regular training with our internal Academy, international experiences by doing a secondment and continuous mentoring on the job. Also, we support you on finding suitable external trainings and further education programmes. Lifestyle – You can accumulate overtime on your annual working time account (JAZ) and compensate for it with time off after busy periods. Any remaining overtime is paid out once a year. You also have 30 days of vacation per calendar year.Health and Wellbeing – Your health is important to us: in addition to our own company health insurance scheme, we also offer preventive medical check-ups and divers sport offerings. Take part in our free company sports programme or benefit from reduced rates at various gyms or an Urban Sports Club membership.And there is even more – It is our purpose to create a positive working environment: An environment where flexible and creative working is possible, where work is recognized and performance is rewarded and of which we are all very proud. You can find more detailed information on all of our benefits on our career website.At PwC Germany, it is our purpose to solve our clients' key challenges, create sustainable outcomes and build trust in business and society. As part of our internal IT team (Products & Technology), you are the driver behind our promise: human-led and tech-powered. We are experts for our technology solutions and make the use of technology easier and more efficient. As a team, we develop innovative solutions for the entire product life cycle and manage the use of technology in the organization. Drive the technological development of PwC Germany in our diverse teams!ContactIf you have any questions about this position or your application, please reach out to Patricia Weiss at +49 69 9585-2222.

starting at the earliest possible opportunity.Your responsibilitiesStrategy – You translate executive business priorities into cloud, GenAI and Agentic AI transformation roadmaps and help clients define their future business and operating models.Transformation – You develop business cases, target operating models and transformation blueprints, while driving process redesign and operating model transformation enabled by Agentic AI.Growth – You collaborate with technical teams to define integrated end-to-end cloud and AI solutions and drive strategic AWS pursuits.Leadership – You shape compelling AWS and AI transformation narratives for C-level stakeholders, influence strategic decision-making, build trusted executive relationships and drive business-led transformation from strategy to execution.Your profile- You have successfully completed a degree in Business Administration, Economics, Technology Management, Computer Science, or a comparable field.- You bring 6-10 years of professional experience in strategy consulting, business transformation, and/or technology strategy, including the development of business cases, operating models and executive-level programs.- You possess deep AWS expertise combined with strong executive advisory capabilities and can translate complex business requirements across cloud, GenAI and Agentic AI into scalable solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes.- You have a proven track record of acting as a trusted advisor to senior client executives, driving strategic initiatives from initial concept through implementation and orchestrating collaboration across business and technology teams.- You communicate confidently in English and German, combine a collaborative and hands-on approach with a strong enthusiasm for GenAI and emerging technologies to turn innovative ideas into tangible client value.Your benefitsFlexibility – In coordination with your team, you can expect a mix of working in the office and home office. There are no core working hours – within the scope of operational requirements and legal regulations, you can organize your working hours flexibly. Also, we support you, If required, in caring for relatives by arranging carers, special leave or part-time models.Lifestyle – You can accumulate overtime in your flex-time account and compensate for it with time off after busy periods. A partial payout is possible once a year. We will be happy to discuss the exact details with you in a personal meeting. You can find more detailed information on all of our benefits on our career website.At PwC Germany, it is our purpose to solve our clients' key challenges, create sustainable outcomes and build trust in business and society. As part of our Experience Consulting team, you will accompany our clients on the way to a new or improved digital product with designs, concepts and qualitative user research. We combine design thinking methods with collaborative workshop formats to involve as many stakeholders as possible from brainstorming to go-live.
